Rahul Gandhi’s remarks on the Israel-Gaza conflict have triggered a political row within the INDIA bloc, with Left parties criticising his support for stronger India-Israel defence ties. CPI(M) leader Pinarayi Vijayan and CPI(ML) Liberation leader Dipankar Bhattacharya have questioned his position, exposing ideological differences within the Opposition alliance. Why has the controversy erupted, and what does it mean for INDIA bloc unity?
Thank you for watching our video!
